messages:
IncidentBot: P1 alert — elevated 5xx rate observed on /status-api in us-west. Pager escalated to oncall. Incident page: https://redwood.incidents/1768202469. Please acknowledge.
Alice (oncall): Ack — I'm on it. Taking incident owner. Creating a temporary meeting room.
Alice (oncall): Meeting room: https://meet.redwood.com/rooms/1768202469 (private).
Ben (platform): Joining now. I'll look at routing and traffic. @Miguel (SRE) can you prepare a scale-up for status-api?
Miguel (SRE): On it — adding 2x replicas to status-api (k8s patch applied).
Carla (support): Noted. Any customer reports yet? I'll check the support queue and prep a short customer notice.
Dmitri (infra): Quick mitigation suggestion: shift non-EU traffic to us-east fallback while we remediate. Command to flip region var:
```
kubectl set env deploy/status-api TRAFFIC_REGION=fallback --namespace=prod
```
Alice (oncall): Good plan. Ben, start the routing change. Miguel confirm when scaling completes. Carla, draft an initial status page blurb (short + ETA).
Ben (platform): Routing change started; watching logs for 5xx improvements. ETA ~3m.
Miguel (SRE): Scaling finished — pods ready. CPU and latency look normal. 5xx persists for some clients, investigating KV cache errors.
Carla (support): Draft status page update:
'We are investigating an elevated error rate affecting the Redwood status API in us-west. Some API requests may return 5xx. Engineers are performing mitigations; next update in 15 minutes.'
Post that?
Alice (oncall): Yes, post that and notify any active customers with open incidents. Use the short-template: impact, action taken, ETA.
Ben (platform): Posted to status page and adjusted routes. Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/1768202469. Notifying #customers-ops with the template.
Dmitri (infra): Found repeated KV cache timeouts coming from host 10.12.5.21. I've excluded that host from LB. Remove command used: `curl -XPOST https://lb/api/remove?host=10.12.5.21`
Miguel (SRE): Will run a rolling restart on the cache cluster after traffic stabilizes. ETA ~10m.
Alice (oncall): Action items:
- Alice: incident owner & comms
- Ben: routing & monitor
- Miguel: scale + cache restart
- Dmitri: isolate bad host
- Carla: customer updates
If anyone else joins, post here. :thumbsup:
Carla (support): Customer-notify posted to #customers-ops and email draft ready for large customers. :white_check_mark:
Ben (platform): 5xx rate dropping ~70% after routing change; tail errors are decreasing. Continuing to watch CDN and KV metrics.
Miguel (SRE): Holding rolling restart pending one more stability check.
Dmitri (infra): Adding a short runbook note: likely root cause = KV host OOM. Attaching logs to the incident page.
Alice (oncall): Thanks team. Reconvene in 10 minutes for the next update. If severity changes, escalate immediately. Closing thread until next status note.
